newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp says Australia dumping issue settled.
newsitem.headline: Sharp says Australia dumping issue settled.

text.p: Sharp Corp said on Wednesday that its dispute with Australia regarding the dumping of a unit's refrigerators on to the market had been settled, and it would not need to pay dumping duties but promised to raise its prices.

"We had discussions with the (Australian) authorities and promised that we would raise prices. As a result of that, we will pay no dumping duties and we have settled the issue," a Sharp spokesman said.

Sharp's move comes after Australia's Anti-Dumping Authority announced on Wednesday that it had concluded that exports of refrigerators from Sharp's Thai unit to Australia had been dumped on to the market.
ADA said the sale of refrigerators at below market prices had damaged Australian industry and there was a threat that future sales by the Sharp unit would continue to hurt Australian industry.
